- **Entertainment** : AI avatar videos are used in virtual concerts, films, and even by influencers, offering new ways to tell stories and connect with audiences in creative, memorable formats.
- **Marketing** : AI avatar videos allow brands to deliver personalized messages in a way that feels human and engaging. From product demos to ad campaigns, these videos help create deeper connections with audiences.

Yet, when done right, AI avatars can look and sound remarkably human. ## Setting Your Goals and Purpose for the AI Avatar Video


Before you start creating an AI avatar video, you must first understand its goals and purpose. Different audiences have different expectations, and tailoring your avatar to meet those expectations starts with understanding what your video is meant to achieve.


To get this right, it’s important to research your target audience. You must know their age, preferences, interests, and communication style. For example, if you’re creating an AI avatar video for a Gen Y influencer, their audience likely values creativity, authenticity, and quick, visually engaging content. In this case, the AI avatar might have a casual, relatable style—think vibrant clothing, playful expressions, and a friendly tone. The goal is to create an avatar that catches the eye to entertain or[promote products](https://ultahost.com/blog/video-marketing-strategies/) in a way that feels natural (or as natural as possible) on social media.


On the other hand, adult education video content needs a more formal, professional AI avatar. The audience here expects clear, authoritative delivery. The avatar might wear professional attire, speak in a calm, steady tone, and deliver information in a structured, digestible, credible, and extremely clear way, as the goal is to educate and inform.


Once you’ve established your goal, research could involve looking at existing content your target audience consumes, analyzing what styles and tones are most effective for them, and using that insight to inform the avatar you create. Remember, the more aligned your AI avatar is with your video’s purpose, the more effective it will be in delivering your message.
